verdict.rationale: Ironclad's own Workflow Designer lets admins design and publish contract workflows, and the platform then enforces approval and signature policies, a form of configured process automation (docs-8, docs-16, docs-15). Most other evidence describes API and webhook building blocks that developers would use to construct background automations themselves (docs-20, docs-39, docs-4), which earn no credit here. missing for 10: documented user-configurable triggers or scheduled automations that run autonomously, any AI-agent or background-task capability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
